cycles.description: Successful primary contacts required for one trigger, counted once per attack with positive damage regardless of collateral. Higher values decrease trigger frequency; this is not a wave count.

stun.description: Stun duration in seconds. A pulse applies stun only and deals no damage.

interval.description: Minimum seconds between pulse triggers, which can further limit the contact threshold frequency.
